name: How much does it cost to replace deck boards?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace deck boards?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to replace deck boards varies widely depending on the material chosen, the size of the deck, and the complexity of the job. For example, replacing with pressure-treated lumber will generally be less expensive than using composite materials. Labor costs also contribute significantly. It's best to get a detailed estimate from a professional contractor to understand the specific costs for your project in the Berkeley or East Bay area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost varies based on material, deck size, and labor. Pressure-treated lumber is typically less expensive than composite. Get a detailed estimate.
